name: Sustain Wild Shape

other: Must be able to cast 5th-level druid spells

benefit: When you transform back to your normal form or into another wild shape, you can sustain your previous form using a full-round action. So long as you sustain your previous form, you may return to that shape without it counting as an additional use of the wild shape ability. You cannot sustain more than one wild shape form at a time.
